AWPTCM-T33315.objective:
• The original CoS value of a packet can be overwritten and replaced using the "remark new-cos" command inside a policy-map class.
  • Applying a policy-map with "remark new-cos" to an ingress port results in egress packets carrying the new specified CoS value.
  • CoS remarking via policy does not cause re-marked traffic to be misdirected to an unintended CPU queue.
  • Support for combined remark: "remark new-cos X internal new-cpu-queue Y" to control both external CoS and internal CPU queue assignment.
  • Default CoS configuration (mls qos cos) and cos-queue maps correctly affect untagged ingress frames and internal queuing on switchports and LAGs.
  • Class-based CoS setting (similar to class set cos) and remarking work consistently on switchport and static LAG interfaces.
  • CoS remarking and mapping configurations survive VCS failovers and reboot from startup config.

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability.

Configure a class-map (e.g. match vlan) and policy-map using "remark new-cos 5 both". Apply service-policy input to ingress switchport. Send traffic with original CoS 3. Verify on egress that CoS is rewritten to 5.
Confirm policy-map is attached using "show policy-map". Verify state attached and remark action visible.
Test that CoS remarking does not alter the CPU queue for traffic that should go to CPU (e.g. unknown dest). Use debug/platform packet recv if needed.
Test combined remark "remark new-cos X internal new-cpu-queue Y" and verify both external CoS and internal CPU queue are set as specified.
Configure mls qos cos on ingress for untagged frames on switchport and static LAG. Verify egress frames carry the configured default CoS tag.
Examine and verify default and configured cos-queue maps using show mls qos maps cos-queue. Test that mappings affect queuing as expected.
Verify class-based CoS setting (class set cos in policy-map) works similarly to remark on switchport and LAG.
Perform VCS failover and reboot. Confirm CoS remarking policy, default cos, and cos-queue map configs are preserved and functional.
